About.title: A developer with a systems mindset.
About.lead: I’m Brahim, a junior full stack developer based in Mauritania. I care about the whole picture: the interface people touch, the API behind it, and the data that keeps everything coherent.
About.body1: I’m currently studying Information Systems Development at SupNum, where I’m building a strong foundation in software engineering, databases, and application architecture.
About.body2: My interests sit at the intersection of web, mobile, and backend development. I learn best by building — from responsive interfaces with Next.js and Angular to Spring Boot services and PostgreSQL schemas.
About.approach: I like clear requirements, small iterations, and code that another person can read without a map. I ask questions early and test the details that users notice.
About.availability: I’m looking for a team where I can contribute, learn quickly, and grow into a well-rounded engineer.
